LOANS_TO_ECONOMY.methodology: Million KZT (converted from the source's thousand-KZT unit). Banking-sector Financial Soundness Indicator, second-tier banks (deposit takers).

FDI_NET_INFLOW.dataset_id: formId=337,code=Direct investment in reporting economy (net inflow),direction=Direct investment in Kazakhstan
FDI_NET_INFLOW.indicator_name: Net Foreign Direct Investment Inflow to Kazakhstan
FDI_NET_INFLOW.description: Чистый приток прямых иностранных инвестиций в Казахстан
FDI_NET_INFLOW.methodology: USD million. Net foreign direct investment inflow to Kazakhstan (BPM6 directional principle) -- from the balance of payments financial account, not the same concept as domestic fixed-capital investment (INVESTMENT).

GOV_SECURITIES_MEUKAM.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. МЕUКАМ (medium/long-term treasury bonds) outstanding -- the single largest domestic government securities instrument type, NOT a total across all instrument types (the source publishes no such total; other types include МЕККАМ, МЕОКАМ, METIKAM, Municipal Government Securities, Notes of NBK -- the latter is a central-bank sterilization instrument, not strictly a government security).

IIP_NET.methodology: USD million. Net International Investment Position (total foreign assets held by Kazakhstan residents minus total foreign liabilities owed by Kazakhstan residents). Negative values indicate a net external liability position.

IIP_ASSETS.methodology: USD million. Total foreign assets held by Kazakhstan residents (International Investment Position, asset side).

IIP_LIABILITIES.methodology: USD million. Total foreign liabilities owed by Kazakhstan residents (International Investment Position, liability side).

CURRENT_ACCOUNT_BALANCE.methodology: USD million. Current account balance of the balance of payments. Negative values indicate a deficit.

BANK_ROA.dataset_id: formId=314,subject=Core FSIs for Deposit takers,indicator=Return on assets
BANK_ROA.methodology: %. Banking-sector Financial Soundness Indicator, second-tier banks (deposit takers).

BANK_ROE.dataset_id: formId=314,subject=Core FSIs for Deposit takers,indicator=Return on equity
BANK_ROE.methodology: %. Banking-sector Financial Soundness Indicator, second-tier banks (deposit takers).

PENSION_FUND_ASSETS.methodology: Million KZT (converted from the source's thousand-KZT unit). Total pension savings held by Kazakhstan's Unified Accumulative Pension Fund (UAPF/ЕНПФ), end of month.

INSURANCE_PREMIUMS_GENERAL.methodology: Million KZT (converted from the source's thousand-KZT unit). Total insurance premiums accepted under insurance and reinsurance contracts, GENERAL (non-life) insurance organizations. Not the same total as INSURANCE_PREMIUMS_LIFE -- the source provides no combined General+Life aggregate.

INSURANCE_PREMIUMS_LIFE.methodology: Million KZT (converted from the source's thousand-KZT unit). Total insurance premiums accepted under insurance and reinsurance contracts, LIFE insurance organizations. Not the same total as INSURANCE_PREMIUMS_GENERAL -- the source provides no combined General+Life aggregate.

PENSION_PAYMENTS.methodology: Million KZT (converted from the source's thousand-KZT unit). Total pension savings payments made from Kazakhstan's Unified Accumulative Pension Fund (UAPF/ЕНПФ) -- year-to-date cumulative within each calendar year, resets each January.

RESERVES_IMPORT_COVER.dataset_id: formId=469,indicator=The value of the international reserves adequate for financing imports
RESERVES_IMPORT_COVER.methodology: Number of months of import cover provided by Kazakhstan's international reserves. NBK's own stated adequate level: at least 3 months.

PRODUCTION_VOLUME_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Production Volume Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
PRODUCTION_VOLUME_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии объёма производства (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
PRODUCTION_VOLUME_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in production volume over the quarter.

PRODUCTION_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.dataset_id: formId=365,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Production volume expectations - Diffusion index
PRODUCTION_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Production Volume Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
PRODUCTION_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий объёма производства (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
PRODUCTION_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED production volume change next quarter.

DEMAND_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии спроса на товары/услуги (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
DEMAND_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in demand for their goods/services over the quarter.

DEMAND_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Demand Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
DEMAND_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий спроса (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
DEMAND_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED demand for their goods/services next quarter.

LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.dataset_id: formId=347,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Acceptable interest rate of loans in tenge
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.indicator_name: Acceptable Interest Rate on Tenge Loans (NBK Enterprise Survey)
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.description: Приемлемая ставка по кредитам в тенге (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.methodology: Percent per annum, average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): the interest rate on TENGE loans that surveyed enterprises report as acceptable for borrowing. A survey-reported willingness measure, not a market rate -- compare against LENDING_RATE for the actual rate.

LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_FX.dataset_id: formId=347,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Acceptable interest rate of loans in foreign currency
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_FX.indicator_name: Acceptable Interest Rate on FX Loans (NBK Enterprise Survey)
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_FX.description: Приемлемая ставка по кредитам в инвалюте (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
LOAN_RATE_ACCEPTABLE_FX.methodology: Percent per annum, average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): the interest rate on FOREIGN-CURRENCY loans that surveyed enterprises report as acceptable for borrowing. A survey-reported willingness measure, not a market rate.

LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.dataset_id: formId=347,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Acceptable term of loans in tenge
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.indicator_name: Acceptable Term of Tenge Loans (NBK Enterprise Survey)
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.description: Приемлемый срок кредитов в тенге (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_KZT.methodology: Months, average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): the loan maturity on TENGE loans that surveyed enterprises report as acceptable for borrowing.

LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_FX.dataset_id: formId=347,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Acceptable term of loans in foreign currency
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_FX.indicator_name: Acceptable Term of FX Loans (NBK Enterprise Survey)
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_FX.description: Приемлемый срок кредитов в инвалюте (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
LOAN_TERM_ACCEPTABLE_FX.methodology: Months, average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): the loan maturity on FOREIGN-CURRENCY loans that surveyed enterprises report as acceptable for borrowing.

INVENTORIES_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии запасов готовой продукции (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
INVENTORIES_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in inventories over the quarter.

INVENTORIES_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Inventories Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
INVENTORIES_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий запасов (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
INVENTORIES_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED change in inventories next quarter.

IMPORT_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.dataset_id: formId=363,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price of imported goods - Diffusion index
IMPORT_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Imported Goods Price Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
IMPORT_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии цен на импортные товары (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
IMPORT_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in the price of IMPORTED goods over the quarter -- an imported-inflation pressure gauge.

IMPORT_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDE.dataset_id: formId=363,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price expectations for imported goods - Diffusion index
IMPORT_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDE.indicator_name: Imported Goods Price Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
IMPORT_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDE.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий цен на импортные товары (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
IMPORT_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSION_INDE.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED change in the price of IMPORTED goods next quarter.

RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.dataset_id: formId=364,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price for raw materials - Diffusion index
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Raw Materials Price Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии цен на сырьё и материалы (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in raw materials prices over the quarter -- a cost-push inflation gauge. History back to 2005-Q2.

RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSI.dataset_id: formId=364,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price for raw materials expectations - Diffusion index
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSI.indicator_name: Raw Materials Price Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSI.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий цен на сырьё и материалы (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
RAW_MATERIALS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUSI.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED change in raw materials prices next quarter. History back to 2005-Q2.

CAPACITY_UTILIZATION.description: Уровень загрузки производственных мощностей (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
CAPACITY_UTILIZATION.methodology: Percent, weighted average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') level of production capacity actually in use -- a standard output-gap/slack indicator.

FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.dataset_id: formId=387,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price for finished goods - Diffusion index
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.indicator_name: Finished Goods Price Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.description: Индекс диффузии цен на готовую продукцию (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_DIFFUSION_INDEX.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in their own FINISHED GOODS prices over the quarter -- an output-price/pass-through inflation gauge. History back to 2005-Q2.

FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUS.dataset_id: formId=387,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Price for finished goods expectations - Diffusion index
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUS.indicator_name: Finished Goods Price Expectations Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUS.description: Индекс диффузии ожиданий цен на готовую продукцию (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
FINISHED_GOODS_PRICE_EXPECTATIONS_DIFFUS.methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' EXPECTED change in their own FINISHED GOODS prices next quarter -- a firm-side inflation-expectations gauge, complementing the household-side INFLATION_EXPECTATIONS. History back to 2005-Q2.

OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_SHARE.indicator_name: Share of Enterprises with Overdue Accounts Payable (NBK Enterprise Survey)
OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_SHARE.description: Доля предприятий с просроченной кредиторской задолженностью
OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_SHARE.methodology: Percent, share of surveyed respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprises reporting OVERDUE ACCOUNTS PAYABLE -- a corporate-distress indicator.

OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_SHARE.indicator_name: Share of Enterprises with Overdue Accounts Receivable (NBK Enterprise Survey)
OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_SHARE.description: Доля предприятий с просроченной дебиторской задолженностью
OVERDUE_ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_SHARE.methodology: Percent, share of surveyed respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprises reporting OVERDUE ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE -- a payment-chain stress indicator.

OVERDUE_BANK_LOANS_SHARE.dataset_id: formId=378,industry=All sectors,indicator_code=Overdue debt on bank loans
OVERDUE_BANK_LOANS_SHARE.indicator_name: Share of Enterprises with Overdue Bank Loan Debt (NBK Enterprise Survey)
OVERDUE_BANK_LOANS_SHARE.description: Доля предприятий с просроченной задолженностью по банковским кредитам
OVERDUE_BANK_LOANS_SHARE.methodology: Percent, share of surveyed respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprises reporting OVERDUE DEBT ON BANK LOANS -- the survey-side counterpart to the banking sector's NPL_RATIO.

ENTERPRISE_DEBT_BURDEN.indicator_name: Average Enterprise Debt Burden (NBK Enterprise Survey)
ENTERPRISE_DEBT_BURDEN.description: Средняя долговая нагрузка предприятий (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
ENTERPRISE_DEBT_BURDEN.methodology: Percent, weighted average across respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprise revenue going to loan payments.

EXPORTERS_SHARE.indicator_name: Share of Exporting Enterprises (NBK Enterprise Survey)
EXPORTERS_SHARE.methodology: Percent, share of surveyed respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprises engaged in EXPORT activity only (the survey reports export-only, import-only, both, and neither as four separate shares).

IMPORTERS_SHARE.indicator_name: Share of Importing Enterprises (NBK Enterprise Survey)
IMPORTERS_SHARE.methodology: Percent, share of surveyed respondents. NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors'): share of enterprises engaged in IMPORT activity only (the survey reports export-only, import-only, both, and neither as four separate shares).

PAYMENTS_TOTAL_VALUE.methodology: Billion KZT. Total value of all payments made through Kazakhstan payment instruments in the month (gross payment turnover, all instruments combined).

CASHLESS_PAYMENTS_VALUE.methodology: Billion KZT. Value of cashless (non-cash) payments in the month. Read together with CASH_WITHDRAWALS_VALUE as a cash-vs-cashless split, and with NON_CASH_PAYMENTS_SHARE.

CASH_WITHDRAWALS_VALUE.methodology: Billion KZT. Value of cash withdrawals in the month -- the cash side of the payment mix.

PAYMENT_CARDS_VALUE.methodology: Billion KZT. Value of payment-card transactions in the month (the source own 'Payment cards, including:' aggregate row, covering both cashless card payments and card cash withdrawals).

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_FIXED_TERM_KZT.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Fixed-term deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, denominated in TENGE. Together with the _FX series this is the standard household deposit dollarization pair.

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_FIXED_TERM_FX.methodology: Million KZT equivalent, end of month. Fixed-term deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, denominated in FOREIGN CURRENCY.

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_KZT.dataset_id: formId=261,currency=National currency,deposit_type=Current account and demand,type=Balance (mln. tenge)
HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_KZT.description: Текущие счета и депозиты до востребования физлиц в тенге
HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_KZT.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Current-account and demand deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, in TENGE.

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_FX.dataset_id: formId=261,currency=Foreign currency,deposit_type=Current account and demand,type=Balance (mln. tenge)
HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_FX.description: Текущие счета и депозиты до востребования физлиц в инвалюте
HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_DEMAND_FX.methodology: Million KZT equivalent, end of month. Current-account and demand deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, in FOREIGN CURRENCY.

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_SAVING_KZT.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Savings deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, in TENGE.

HOUSEHOLD_DEPOSITS_SAVING_FX.methodology: Million KZT equivalent, end of month. Savings deposits of INDIVIDUALS in second-tier banks, in FOREIGN CURRENCY.

LOANS_BUSINESS_KZT.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Banking sector,currency=National currency,period=Month,subject_type=Business,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_BUSINESS_KZT.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Outstanding banking-sector loans to BUSINESS borrowers, in TENGE.

LOANS_BUSINESS_FX.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Banking sector,currency=Foreign currency,period=Month,subject_type=Business,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_BUSINESS_FX.indicator_name: Bank Loans to Business, Foreign Currency
LOANS_BUSINESS_FX.methodology: Million KZT equivalent, end of month. Outstanding banking-sector loans to BUSINESS borrowers, in FOREIGN CURRENCY -- the corporate side of credit dollarization.

LOANS_INDIVIDUALS_KZT.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Banking sector,currency=National currency,period=Month,subject_type=Individuals,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_INDIVIDUALS_KZT.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Outstanding banking-sector loans to INDIVIDUALS, in TENGE -- Kazakhstan household credit stock.

LOANS_INDIVIDUALS_FX.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Banking sector,currency=Foreign currency,period=Month,subject_type=Individuals,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_INDIVIDUALS_FX.indicator_name: Bank Loans to Individuals, Foreign Currency
LOANS_INDIVIDUALS_FX.methodology: Million KZT equivalent, end of month. Outstanding banking-sector loans to INDIVIDUALS, in FOREIGN CURRENCY (a very small residual stock since FX retail lending was restricted).

LOANS_MICROFINANCE_INDIVIDUALS.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Microfinance activities,currency=National currency,period=Month,subject_type=Individuals,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_MICROFINANCE_INDIVIDUALS.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Outstanding MICROFINANCE-sector loans to INDIVIDUALS, in TENGE -- non-bank consumer credit, outside the banking-sector aggregates.

LOANS_MICROFINANCE_BUSINESS.dataset_id: formId=445,creditors=Microfinance activities,currency=National currency,period=Month,subject_type=Business,type=mln. of KZT, end of period
LOANS_MICROFINANCE_BUSINESS.methodology: Million KZT, end of month. Outstanding MICROFINANCE-sector loans to BUSINESS borrowers, in TENGE.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_LONG_TERM.dataset_id: formId=340,class_type=Total External debt of Kazakhstan,matiruty=Long-term,period=Quarter,type= mln USD
EXTERNAL_DEBT_LONG_TERM.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. LONG-TERM portion of Kazakhstan total gross external debt. Together with EXTERNAL_DEBT_SHORT_TERM this is the maturity split behind EXTERNAL_DEBT.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_SHORT_TERM.dataset_id: formId=340,class_type=Total External debt of Kazakhstan,matiruty=Short-term,period=Quarter,type= mln USD
EXTERNAL_DEBT_SHORT_TERM.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. SHORT-TERM portion of Kazakhstan total gross external debt -- the rollover-risk component, and the numerator concept behind reserve-adequacy rules such as RESERVES_IMPORT_COVER.

PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_INTERCOMPANY.dataset_id: formId=340,class_type=Private Sector External Debt,matiruty=Long-term,name_eng=Direct investment: Intercompany lending,period=Quarter,type= mln USD
PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_INTERCOMPANY.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term private-sector external debt in the form of DIRECT INVESTMENT INTERCOMPANY LENDING -- the dominant component of Kazakhstan external debt, largely oil-sector parent-to-subsidiary financing rather than market borrowing.

PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_OTHER_LT.dataset_id: formId=340,class_type=Private Sector External Debt,matiruty=Long-term,name_eng=Banks and Other Sectors,period=Quarter,type= mln USD
PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_OTHER_LT.indicator_name: Private External Debt: Banks and Other Sectors, Long-Term
PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_OTHER_LT.description: Частный внешний долг: банки и прочие сектора, долгосрочный
PRIVATE_EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_OTHER_LT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term private-sector external debt of BANKS AND OTHER SECTORS, excluding intercompany lending -- the market-borrowing part of private external debt.

GOLD_BULLION_SALES.indicator_name: Refined Gold Bullion Bars Sold to the Public
GOLD_BULLION_SALES.methodology: Number of bars. Refined gold bullion bars sold to the public by second-tier banks and non-bank exchange offices -- a retail gold-demand / household savings-behavior indicator.

REMITTANCES_SENT_USD.methodology: Million KZT equivalent. Cross-border money transfers SENT from Kazakhstan denominated in US DOLLARS. Currency composition behind the REMITTANCES_SENT total.

REMITTANCES_SENT_KZT.methodology: Million KZT. Cross-border money transfers SENT from Kazakhstan denominated in TENGE.

REMITTANCES_SENT_RUB.methodology: Million KZT equivalent. Cross-border money transfers SENT from Kazakhstan denominated in RUSSIAN RUBLES.

REMITTANCES_RECEIVED_USD.methodology: Million KZT equivalent. Cross-border money transfers RECEIVED in Kazakhstan denominated in US DOLLARS.

REMITTANCES_RECEIVED_KZT.methodology: Million KZT. Cross-border money transfers RECEIVED in Kazakhstan denominated in TENGE.

REMITTANCES_RECEIVED_RUB.methodology: Million KZT equivalent. Cross-border money transfers RECEIVED in Kazakhstan denominated in RUSSIAN RUBLES.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_GOV_LOANS_LT.indicator_name: External Debt: General Government Loans, Long-Term
EXTERNAL_DEBT_GOV_LOANS_LT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term external debt of the GENERAL GOVERNMENT in the form of LOANS -- the sovereign borrowing component of external debt.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_LOANS_LT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term external debt of BANKS in the form of LOANS.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_SECURITIES_LT.indicator_name: External Debt: Bank Debt Securities, Long-Term
EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_SECURITIES_LT.description: Внешний долг: долговые ценные бумаги банков, долгосрочные
EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS_SECURITIES_LT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term external debt of BANKS in the form of DEBT SECURITIES (eurobond-style market borrowing).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_OTHER_SECURITIES_LT.indicator_name: External Debt: Other Sectors Debt Securities, Long-Term
EXTERNAL_DEBT_OTHER_SECURITIES_LT.description: Внешний долг: долговые ценные бумаги прочих секторов, долгосрочные
EXTERNAL_DEBT_OTHER_SECURITIES_LT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Long-term external debt of OTHER SECTORS (non-bank corporates) in the form of DEBT SECURITIES.

GOV_SECURITIES_SECONDARY_NBK_NOTES.indicator_name: Government Securities Secondary Market: NBK Notes Volume
GOV_SECURITIES_SECONDARY_NBK_NOTES.description: Вторичный рынок ГЦБ: ноты НБ РК, объём сделок
GOV_SECURITIES_SECONDARY_NBK_NOTES.methodology: Million KZT. Secondary-market transaction volume in NBK Notes -- a liquidity/turnover measure for the National Bank short-term sterilization instrument, distinct from the outstanding stock in GOV_SECURITIES_MEUKAM.

TOURISM_VALUE_ADDED.description: Валовая добавленная стоимость, создаваемая непосредственно в туризме
TOURISM_VALUE_ADDED.methodology: KZT. Gross value added created directly by tourism, from BNS's Tourism Satellite Account (Taldau code 115103). Same KZT scale as GDP_INCOME_METHOD and the other BNS national-accounts series.

TOURISM_GDP_SHARE.indicator_name: Tourism Direct Gross Value Added, Share of GDP
TOURISM_GDP_SHARE.description: Доля валовой добавленной стоимости туризма в ВВП
TOURISM_GDP_SHARE.methodology: Percent of GDP contributed directly by tourism (Taldau code 115105), from BNS's Tourism Satellite Account.

TOURISM_EMPLOYMENT.methodology: Number of persons employed in tourism industries (Taldau code 115604).

TOURISM_EMPLOYMENT_SHARE.indicator_name: Tourism Employment, Share of Total Employment
TOURISM_EMPLOYMENT_SHARE.description: Доля занятых в туризме в общей численности занятых
TOURISM_EMPLOYMENT_SHARE.methodology: Percent of Kazakhstan's total employed population working in tourism industries (Taldau code 11560102).

TOURISM_INBOUND_CONSUMPTION.methodology: KZT. Consumption attributable to INBOUND tourism -- spending in Kazakhstan by non-resident visitors (Taldau code 11510104). The tourism-export side.

TOURISM_OUTBOUND_CONSUMPTION.methodology: KZT. Consumption attributable to OUTBOUND tourism -- spending abroad by Kazakhstani residents (Taldau code 11510105). The tourism-import side.

TOURISM_INBOUND_TRIPS.methodology: Number of inbound tourism trips (Taldau code 115801). Short series -- the source publishes it only from 2020.

TOURISM_DOMESTIC_TRIPS.methodology: Number of domestic tourism trips by residents within Kazakhstan (Taldau code 115803). Short series -- published only from 2020.

TOURISM_OUTBOUND_TRIPS.methodology: Number of outbound tourism trips by Kazakhstani residents (Taldau code 115805). Short series -- published only from 2020.

TOURISM_INBOUND_NIGHTS.methodology: Number of nights spent in Kazakhstan by inbound visitors (Taldau code 115802). Short series -- published only from 2020.

LIFE_EXPECTANCY.methodology: Months. Life expectancy at birth for the total population (both sexes, all localities, national). The source publishes this in MONTHS under measure_id=154 -- divide by 12 for the conventional figure in years (2024: 905.28 months = 75.44 years).

EXCHANGE_RATE_EUR_OTC.description: Средний курс евро на внебиржевом рынке (покупка)
EXCHANGE_RATE_EUR_OTC.methodology: KZT per 1 EUR. Average BID rate on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market. Distinct from the official NBK rate (EXCHANGE_RATE, USD only) -- this is a market average, and the form also publishes a near-identical 'Average rate - offer' series.

EXCHANGE_RATE_RUB_OTC.description: Средний курс рубля на внебиржевом рынке (покупка)
EXCHANGE_RATE_RUB_OTC.methodology: KZT per 1 RUB. Average BID rate on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market -- relevant given Russia's weight in Kazakhstan's trade and remittance flows.

EXCHANGE_RATE_USD_OTC.description: Средний курс доллара на внебиржевом рынке (покупка)
EXCHANGE_RATE_USD_OTC.methodology: KZT per 1 USD. Average BID rate on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market. Compare against EXCHANGE_RATE, which is the official NBK rate -- the two are different concepts and will not match exactly.

FX_OTC_VOLUME_USD.dataset_id: formId=41,currency=US dollars,type=Volume - bid (mln. units of currency)

FX_OTC_VOLUME_USD.description: Объём покупки долларов на внебиржевом рынке
FX_OTC_VOLUME_USD.methodology: Million USD. Purchase (bid) turnover in US dollars on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market.

FX_OTC_VOLUME_EUR.description: Объём покупки евро на внебиржевом рынке
FX_OTC_VOLUME_EUR.methodology: Million EUR. Purchase (bid) turnover in euro on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market.

FX_OTC_VOLUME_RUB.dataset_id: formId=41,currency=Russian ruble,type=Volume - bid (mln. units of currency)
FX_OTC_VOLUME_RUB.indicator_name: FX OTC Market Volume, Russian Rubles (Bid)
FX_OTC_VOLUME_RUB.description: Объём покупки рублей на внебиржевом рынке
FX_OTC_VOLUME_RUB.methodology: Million RUB. Purchase (bid) turnover in Russian rubles on Kazakhstan's over-the-counter FX market.

OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS.dataset_id: formId=26,class_type=Net foreign assets,code=Net foreign assets,row_code=Net foreign assets,type=Stocks (mln. tenge)
OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS.indicator_name: Other Financial Corporations: Net Foreign Assets
OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS.methodology: Million KZT. NET FOREIGN ASSETS of other financial corporations (non-bank financial sector: pension fund, insurers, brokers, etc.), from NBK's analytical survey. Equals claims on nonresidents less liabilities to nonresidents.

OFC_CLAIMS_ON_NONRESIDENTS.dataset_id: formId=26,class_type=Net foreign assets,code=Claims on nonresidents,row_code=Claims on nonresidents,subtype1=Claims on nonresidents,type=Stocks (mln. tenge)
OFC_CLAIMS_ON_NONRESIDENTS.indicator_name: Other Financial Corporations: Claims on Nonresidents
OFC_CLAIMS_ON_NONRESIDENTS.methodology: Million KZT. Gross CLAIMS ON NONRESIDENTS held by other financial corporations -- the asset side of OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS.

OFC_LIABILITIES_TO_NONRESIDENTS.dataset_id: formId=26,class_type=Net foreign assets,code=Less: liabilities to nonresidents,row_code=Liabilities to nonresidents,subtype1=Liabilities to nonresidents,type=Stocks (mln. tenge)
OFC_LIABILITIES_TO_NONRESIDENTS.indicator_name: Other Financial Corporations: Liabilities to Nonresidents
OFC_LIABILITIES_TO_NONRESIDENTS.methodology: Million KZT. Gross LIABILITIES TO NONRESIDENTS of other financial corporations -- the liability side of OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS.

OFC_CLAIMS_ON_BANKING_SYSTEM.dataset_id: formId=26,class_type=Claims on banking system,code=Claims on banking system,row_code=Claims on banking system,type=Stocks (mln. tenge)
OFC_CLAIMS_ON_BANKING_SYSTEM.indicator_name: Other Financial Corporations: Claims on Banking System
OFC_CLAIMS_ON_BANKING_SYSTEM.description: Требования прочих финорганизаций к банковской системе
OFC_CLAIMS_ON_BANKING_SYSTEM.methodology: Million KZT. Claims of other financial corporations on Kazakhstan's banking system -- the non-bank financial sector's exposure to banks.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_GENERAL_GOVERNMENT.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Gross external debt of the GENERAL GOVERNMENT. Part of the sector split that sums exactly to EXTERNAL_DEBT_EX_INTERCOMPANY.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_CENTRAL_BANK.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Gross external debt of the CENTRAL BANK (National Bank of Kazakhstan).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_BANKS.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Gross external debt of BANKS (second-tier banking sector).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_OTHER_SECTORS.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Gross external debt of OTHER SECTORS (non-bank corporates and households), excluding intercompany lending.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_EX_INTERCOMPANY.dataset_id: formId=349,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt - Reference: ED not included intercompany lending,period=quarter,type=USD mln
EXTERNAL_DEBT_EX_INTERCOMPANY.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Gross external debt EXCLUDING direct-investment intercompany lending -- the market-borrowing measure. Intercompany lending dominates Kazakhstan's headline external debt (largely oil-sector parent-to-subsidiary financing), so this is the more comparable figure.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_PUBLIC_SECTOR.dataset_id: formId=350,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt - Reference: Public sector ED,period=quarter,type=USD mln
EXTERNAL_DEBT_PUBLIC_SECTOR.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. PUBLIC SECTOR external debt (government, central bank, and entities controlled by government). With EXTERNAL_DEBT_PRIVATE_SECTOR this sums exactly to total EXTERNAL_DEBT.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_PRIVATE_SECTOR.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. PRIVATE SECTOR external debt. With EXTERNAL_DEBT_PUBLIC_SECTOR this sums exactly to total EXTERNAL_DEBT.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_GOV_GUARANTEED.dataset_id: formId=350,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt - Reference: Government and government guaranteed ED,period=quarter,type=USD mln
EXTERNAL_DEBT_GOV_GUARANTEED.description: Государственный и гарантированный государством внешний долг
EXTERNAL_DEBT_GOV_GUARANTEED.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. Government and GOVERNMENT-GUARANTEED external debt -- the sovereign's direct plus contingent external obligations.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_LOANS.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt in the form of LOANS -- the largest instrument category. Part of the instrument split that sums exactly to total EXTERNAL_DEBT.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_DEBT_SECURITIES.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt in the form of DEBT SECURITIES (eurobonds and similar market instruments).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_TRADE_CREDITS.dataset_id: formId=351,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt - Trade credits and advances,period=quarter,type=USD mln
EXTERNAL_DEBT_TRADE_CREDITS.indicator_name: External Debt: Trade Credits and Advances
EXTERNAL_DEBT_TRADE_CREDITS.description: Внешний долг: торговые кредиты и авансы
EXTERNAL_DEBT_TRADE_CREDITS.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt in the form of TRADE CREDITS AND ADVANCES.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_CURRENCY_DEPOSITS.description: Внешний долг: наличная валюта и депозиты
EXTERNAL_DEBT_CURRENCY_DEPOSITS.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt in the form of CURRENCY AND DEPOSITS (mainly non-resident deposits held with Kazakhstani banks).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_SDR.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt in the form of SPECIAL DRAWING RIGHTS (the IMF SDR allocation, carried as a liability).

EXTERNAL_DEBT_OTHER_LIABILITIES.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. OTHER debt liabilities -- the residual instrument category completing the split.

EXTERNAL_DEBT_DUE_WITHIN_YEAR.dataset_id: formId=348,class_type=Debt,ed_code=External Debt- Reference: ED due for payment within one year,period=quarter,type=USD mln
EXTERNAL_DEBT_DUE_WITHIN_YEAR.indicator_name: External Debt Due Within One Year (Remaining Maturity)
EXTERNAL_DEBT_DUE_WITHIN_YEAR.description: Внешний долг к погашению в течение года
EXTERNAL_DEBT_DUE_WITHIN_YEAR.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. External debt DUE FOR PAYMENT WITHIN ONE YEAR on a remaining-maturity basis -- short-term debt plus the current portion of long-term debt. This is the rollover-risk measure, and is larger than EXTERNAL_DEBT_SHORT_TERM, which is on an original-maturity basis.

RESERVES_AND_NATIONAL_FUND.dataset_id: formId=485,account_type_code=financial,code=Reserve assets + Foreign assets of the National Fund,  end of period ,investment_type_code=Reserve assets and National Fund,period=quarter,type=USD mln
RESERVES_AND_NATIONAL_FUND.indicator_name: International Reserves plus National Fund Assets
RESERVES_AND_NATIONAL_FUND.description: Резервы НБ РК и Нацфонда суммарно
RESERVES_AND_NATIONAL_FUND.methodology: USD million, end of quarter. NBK reserve assets PLUS the foreign assets of the National Fund -- Kazakhstan's total external buffer. Held separately from FX_RESERVES (NBK reserves only, monthly) and NATIONAL_FUND_ASSETS (fund only, monthly); this is the combined figure on a balance-of-payments basis, with history back to 2005.

RESERVES_AND_NF_IMPORT_COVER.dataset_id: formId=485,account_type_code=financial,code=Reserve assets and National Fund  in months of import of goods and services,investment_type_code=Reserve assets and National Fund,period=quarter,type=USD mln
RESERVES_AND_NF_IMPORT_COVER.indicator_name: Reserves plus National Fund, Import Cover
RESERVES_AND_NF_IMPORT_COVER.methodology: Months of goods-and-services imports covered by reserve assets PLUS National Fund foreign assets. Broader than RESERVES_IMPORT_COVER, which counts NBK reserve assets only.

RESERVES_AND_NF_GDP_SHARE.dataset_id: formId=485,account_type_code=financial,code=in % of GDP2,investment_type_code=Reserve assets and National Fund,period=quarter,type=USD mln
RESERVES_AND_NF_GDP_SHARE.indicator_name: Reserves plus National Fund, % of GDP

NATIONAL_FUND_GDP_SHARE.methodology: Percent of GDP. Foreign assets of the National Fund of Kazakhstan as a share of GDP.

RESERVE_ASSETS_GDP_SHARE.methodology: Percent of GDP. NBK reserve assets as a share of GDP.

FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_BALANCE.methodology: USD million. Balance of the FINANCIAL ACCOUNT of the balance of payments, excluding reserve assets -- the direct counterpart to CURRENT_ACCOUNT_BALANCE.

BOP_OVERALL_BALANCE_GDP_SHARE.methodology: Percent of GDP. OVERALL BALANCE of the balance of payments.

CRUDE_BIRTH_RATE.methodology: Births per 1000 population (Taldau code 612101). Cross-checks against the existing BIRTHS_TOTAL and POPULATION_BNS series.

CUSTOMS_DUTIES.methodology: Built from 13 of 13 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (0 skipped -- missing sheet or unparseable period/row). Million KZT, republican budget only. YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE, resets near zero each January -- do not read a January value as a sudden collapse from the prior December's much larger cumulative figure; that is the expected pattern for a cumulative-since-Jan-1 series, not a data error. Document TITLES ('as of {Month} 1') are NOT used to determine period -- they were found unreliable; only each document's own internal period text is trusted.
